scoring_justification: Full recompute from raw particle histories is infeasible in the verifier; beam radii compared to paper gold with tolerance. For flux profile, 80% radius recomputed from agent's profile and checked against gold.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold effective beam radii at 400, 350, 300, 250 km for 10 keV total H⁺+H (from Figure 4c) and gold H⁺ beam radius at 350 km (from Figure 4a)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: digitized from Figure 4c and Figure 4a of the paper
hidden_assets.generation_method: approximate reading from the published figure; Table 1 confirms peak radius 169 km
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: values are faithful to the paper's reported curve shape and magnitude

outputs.description: Effective beam radius (80% radius) of downward H⁺+H fluxes at altitudes 400, 350, 300, and 250 km.

units.downward_Hplus_flux: arbitrary units normalized to 1 erg/cm²/s total flux

outputs.description: Azimuthally averaged downward H⁺ flux as a function of radial distance at 350 km altitude.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compare the submitted beam radii to paper-reported reference values with an appropriate tolerance, and will verify the flux profile shape and values against the published profile using a tolerance that accounts for statistical and implementation differences. No gold values or tolerances are disclosed here.
